I know I’m nitpicking. But the way people talk and write about the Iran war bugs me. 

“Ceasefire” has never meant “end of war.” 

More to the point: so long as we are imposing a naval blockade on Iran, we are waging war on Iran. I support the blockade, but it’s an act of war.
